tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i bsnyen pa'i gsal byed gdams pa rin chen 'bar ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī ma hā kā la ya/ 'dir dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i bsnyen pa byed par 'dod pa la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum/ dang po sbyor ba la yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ chag brdar sogs gtsang sbra dang ldan par mchod stegs ji ltar rigs pa la/ yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi gtor ma lnga'am gsum bya/ khyad par 'di nyid kyi gtor ma zlum gtor che ba gcig zur du byas/ mchod pa chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga thun mong du bshams pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ thun gsum du byed de/ thun dang po ni tho rangs kyi cha'am/ snga dro ji ltar rigs pa la lam dus sogs byed bzhin pa yin na/ 'chag med de rnams song nas byed/ de bzhin min na thog ma nyid nas byed de/ gang ltar yang / sa lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i/ sgrub thabs bdud 'joms rdo rje bzhin skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bzlas pa'i bar ji ltar ba bzhin byed/ bzlas pa'i skabs su dmigs pa la/ rang nyid rdo rje nag po chen por gsal ba'i snying gar nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje gri gug sngo nag de'i yu ba'i dbus su yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag de'i mtha' skor du/ dang por yi ge bdun ma/ de nas bcu gnyis ma/ de nas sha sa nas bskor bar bsam/ hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu/ sems can yongs la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcad/ gur gyi mgon po'i skur byas/ gzhan yang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs mgon po'i skur gyur nas/ rang gi sngags bzla grogs byed par bsam/ khyad par bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos bsrung rnams la phog pas thugs brgyud bskul bzlas pa'i grogs mdzad par bsam la/

sngags kyi sgra 'brug gi sgra lta bu 'ur chem chem bsgom/ 'od zer tshur 'dus bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad sngags kyi rnam pa'am/ hūm̐ yig dang 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par byung nas rang la thim pas brgyud byin gyi rlabs cing / gzi brjid nus mthu rgyas par bsam la/ dang por yi ge bdun ma/ thun bsdud ma ran bar 'dren/ thun 'phro gcod khar yi ge bcu gnyis ma dang / shā sa na ji ltar rigs pa byas la bzlas 'phro gcod pa na/ phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ rang gi kha rlangs phog par byas nas bzlas pa'i nus pa thams cad bsdus te spyi bor thim zhing sngags kyi nus pa rnams brtan par byas pa'i mos pa byed cing / spyi bor phreng ba bzhag go /ngag tu bcom ldan 'das bdag dang zhes pa nas/ byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /de rnams kyi bzlas pa thugs brgyud bskul ba song nas/ da mchod gtor gyi brnyes shing phrin las zhu ba'i phyir/ mgon po'i gtor ma zur pa de nang mchod chu chang gis skabs 'dir sbyang ba'am/ thun gyi gong du sbyang bas kyang khyab/ de nas gtor ma de a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs pa nas ha ho hrīḥces pa'i bar kye rdor bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma/ mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhes pa nas hūm̐ dang bh+yoḥ'i sgra sgrog pa'i bar dang / mgon po'i thugs ka nas ya/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas maṃ mdun du 'phros pa las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ ya las nag po gnod sbyin zhes pa nas dam bzhag gi bar gtor chog dgra las rnam rgyal lam/ byung na sa lo tsā bas mdzad pa gong na kye rdo rje'i gtor bsngo bsdus pa gcig yod pa'i nang gi lha brgyad bskyed lugs ji lta ba bzhin byed/

bka' bsgo dam bzhag tshar nas/ lag pa pad skor dang / gtor ma phul ba'i phyag rgya bya zhing / oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya ma hā kā li de wī sa pa ri wā ra na māḥsar+b+ba ces pa dang / sha sa na dang / oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ces dang / oṃ i li sogs gtor sngags tshang ba tshar gsum mam/ lnga/ bdun/ bcu gcig gang rung gi phul/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyi phyi mchod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi badz+ra kā la badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa/ kā lī yak+ṣi ṇi/ yak+ṣa pu tra/ ru tra bha ṭa/ ru lu rak+ṣa si sa pa ri wa ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces pas nang mchod/ de nas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgyal chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi nas 'jig rten du bde legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi/ gnas skabs kyi dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi nas mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang mthun pa yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i 'phrin bcol 'dod don zhu ba/ rang gi blo la gang yod re ba med pa'i tshul du zhu/ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba po/ /mgon po gri gug thod pa can/ /kha dog nag cing ro la zhon/ /nag po che la bdag phyag 'tshal lo/ /bh+yoḥdapal ldan lha mo re ma ti/ /srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur zhing / /'dod khams gtso mo mkha' 'gro'i mchog /dus mtshan nag mo khyod la bstod/ /nag po gnod sbyin yab yum dang / /pu tra bha ṭa ral gcig ma/ /ru 'dren sde bzhi la sogs pa'i/

/bstan bsrung 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /dam rdzas mchod rdzas 'di bzhes la/ /thub pa'i bstan pa dar ba dang / /bstan 'dzin sku tshe rab brtan zhing / /'jig rten bde zhing skyid par mdzod/ /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag gi/ /mi mthun bar chad zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams rab rgyas te/ /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /ces bstod la 'phrin las bcol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs sh+lau ka gcig gi mjug tu/ ras bris yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa gsang rten byed kyi yod na de la bstim/ med na rang gi snying gar hūm̐ la thim zhing / dus da nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas bsrung ba dang / skyabs pa dang / sba ba dang / bgo ba dang / mnyes pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swāhā/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /myur du sgrub nas tshe 'di kho na la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /ces pas dge ba bsngo/ hūm̐ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin bsgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la/ /bar chad bsrung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /chos skyong bsrungs ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /ces pa bkra shis te thun dang po'o/ /'di'i bar du gtor ma brgya rtsa la sogs pa ngag 'don yod na byed/ de nas thun gnyis pa la yang / mgon po'i gtor ma zur pa de gsos nas nang mchod sogs kyi sbyang la bzhag rang nyid stan la 'dug ste sgrub thabs bdud 'joms rdo rje skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bkra shis kyi bar gong dang khyad par med pa ji lta ba bzhin la sngags nyi ma ma rgas tsam gyi bar du 'dren pa ste thun gnyis pa'o/ /yang sngar bzhin lam dus la sogs 'chag med gang yod rnams 'di'i skabs su ma chag tsam ma gtogs rgyas rgyas mi bya sngags thun la gnod pas so/

/de nas thun gsum pa la/ yi dam sogs kyi gtor ma gang yod rnams bsang sbyangs pa dang / bskang gso byed na dgos pa'i yo byad rnams bshams/ mchod pa rnams kyang thun gong ma gnyis la kha gso ba tsam byas la 'dir thams cad gsar pa spo yang skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bzlas pa bsdus pa'i bar gong dang khyad par med/ gtor bsngor slebs pa dang / phur pa/ kye rdor/ bde mchog rnal 'byor ma/ gshed dmar sogs yi dam gang 'bul rnams dang / de mthun chos skyong yang / lha mo dmag zor ma/ dud gsol lha mo/ mgon po zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po ste 'di bzhi las mgon gyi gong du 'bul/ gzhan chos skyong gang 'bul rnams las mgon gyi 'og tu 'bul lo/ /'on kyang 'di'i bsnyen pa'i skabs su/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ phyag drug pa rnams la 'bul yang mi nyan/ gtor ma bsre ru yang mi rung ngo / /'chag med 'bul bzhin pa yin na zur du 'bul dgos te/ tshub che bas rtog pa zhib 'tshal/ 'di bzhin phyag len 'di 'dra la/ /rtog pa rgod cing rtag gzo yi/ /gdams ngag snying chu'i gdams pa zhes/ /yod ces bya ba'i yod snyam dang / /bla ma'i phyag len bla ma yi/ /mdzad pa mthong zhing mdzad ces pa/ /haṃ lab gnyis phung haṃ lab can/ /tshod cig rang sems tshod cig gzung / /'di bzhin rang bzo'i nga rgyal can/ /phyag len yangs por stong byed cing / /mi shes shes bya'i rgyab rten la/ /bla ma zhing gzhan gshegs pa kun/ /gsung zhes bla ma'i zhabs 'dren byed/ /tshe 'di'i khe grags kho nas khyer/ /rang las mkhas shing grub pa brnyes/ /sangs rgyas dngos su 'dug go zhes/ /kun gyi snyan grags brjod re nas/ /phyi ma rol med btang ba'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir snyan grags cung zad med/ /snyan grags 'dod na 'di bzhin mdzod/ /dang por bla ma mkhas pa bsten/ /de nas rang bzo'i skyon cig spong / /gang zag kun la dag snang sbyong / /chos la dag snang sbyongs sbyong nas/

/rang gi bla ma'i gsung rgyun dang / /mdo rgyud kun dang 'gal nyen yod/ /dag snang sbyong sa ma nor ba/ /gtad yod chos gcig byas gyur na/ /tshe 'dir snyan grags rang shugs 'phel/ /phyi ma 'bad med lhun gyi grub/ /'di bzhin kun la zhus pa yin/ /re res khro zur ston mi dgos/ /snying chu bsre ba'i gdams pa dang / /mkhon nag zas kyi gdams pa sogs/ /shin tu mang ba yod mod kyi/ /bla ma las thob phyag len rnams/ /spom yor ma lus rtsa brdar bcad/ /shin tu dag pa dgos zhes pa'i/ /gsal 'debs tsam zhig byas pa lags/ /de bzhin min pa'i nga rgyal dang / /phrag dog kho nas byas min pas/ /kun gyi dgongs la bzod pa bzhes/ /de nas gtor ma rnams phul rjes yi ge brgya pa ji ltar rigs pa dang / yi dam gyi sngags kyi mgo mnan nas chos skyong gi sngags rnams cung zad re bzla/ de skabs kyi dmigs pa ni mang du yod kyang bsdu na sgrub thabs bdud 'joms kyi mjug na yod pa bzhin rang mgon por gsal ba'i snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros mdun gyi chos skyong rnams la phog pas rang gzhan gyi dam tshig nyams chags kyi grib phog pa thams cad bsangs/ de dag gi thugs ka'i 'od zer tshur rang la phog pas rang gi rgyud byin gyi rlabs par bsam pa'o/ /de nas phyi mchod cig byas la bshags pa rgyas bsdus gang rung bya/ bskang gso byed na 'dir byed/ de nas bstod pa byed do/ /bskang gso mi byed na bstod pa gang shes byas pas khyab/ rjes chog gi skabs su gzhan khyad par med cing / rten yod na brtan bzhugs/ med na lha brgyad rang la bsdu/ gzhan rnams ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o/ /de nas bsngo ba dang smon lam/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi bkra shis gang shes rgyas bsdus blo dang bstun nas byed pa ste thun gsum pa'o/ /de ltar gtor bsngo rgyas pa sogs byed pa/ sngags kyi khyad mnga' yong na thun gnyis pa'i mjug tu byas pas kyang khyab/

thun mtshams su lus sems ngal dub spang ba'i phyir ci bder rgyu ste chos dang mthun zhing byams snying rje bsgom mo/ /bsnyen tshad ni/ rab 'bum khrag brgya'am/ lnga bcu/ 'bring nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ bcu bzhi/ tha ma bdun dang / kha bskong gcig dang brgyad do/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ mā hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa no pa ha ri ṇi/ e ṣa/ a pañtsi ma/ kā lor+dha ya i daṃ/ rat+na tra ya/ a pa ka ri ṇaṃ/ ma di satwaṃ/ pra ti dzña sma ra si/ ta da/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭan/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ de na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sngags 'di rnams ni 'dren rgyu dang / gtor ma gnyis ka la phan bsam phyag ris ngo bo la yig 'bru re re nas bshus te zhus dag yang du ma zhig byas pas dag cing yid ches yod do// ༈ /kye ma snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus/ /chos bzhin byed pa'i skyes bu ni/ /nyin mo'i skar ma las kyang dkon/ /re re tsam la'ang bar chad mang / /bar chad de nyid bzlog pa'i thabs/ /bla ma rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /gdams pa rgya mtsho'i nang nas yang / /rdo rje gur nas gsungs pa yi/ /bstan bsrungs kun gyi gtso bo ste/ /mahā kā la 'khor bcas rnams/ /sa lam bar chad sel ba'i mchog /ngo mtshar can 'di bsten 'tshal lo/ /bsnyen pa byed pa'i phyag len gyis/ /gsal byed nyung la don tshang 'di/ /chos kyi dpal 'byor bskul ba'i ngor/ /sa lo chen po'i zhabs bsten pa'i/ /'khon gyi rigs can sa skya pa'i/ /ngag gi dbang pos 'gro ba kun/ /dga' zhing rin chen dam chos la/ /spyod cing bkra shis 'byung ba'i phyir/ /bdag gi dad pas sbyar ba yin/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i yi ge pa/ /rnam dpyod blo dang ldan pa'i mchog /zla ba grags pa'i lag sor gyis/ /nye bar bri ba'i skyen byas so/ /'di las byung ba'i dge ba yis/ /bdud bzhi'i bar chad nyer zhi nas/

/rab dga' la sogs myur bgrod de/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i bsnyen pa'i gsal byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
